title: Rails ActiveRecord ORDER BY Injection via Sort Param
learning_objectives: Recognise ActiveRecord order() SQL injection when a sort param reaches ORDER BY through Arel.sql
Explain why strong parameters bind where-hash conditions but do nothing for a raw sort string
Construct a boolean oracle from row ORDERING alone, with no error text and no data echoed in the body
Blind-extract a database secret character-by-character through a sort-based side channel
flag_hint: Recover secrets.master_key (16 lowercase-hex chars) through the ORDER BY ordering oracle, then POST /solve {"key":"<16hex>"}. /solve verifies the key and reads $FLAG_PATH in code (no shell) to return the flag.
inspired_by: Rails ActiveRecord order()/Arel.sql raw-SQL injection (Brakeman SQL_Injection detector) and PortSwigger blind ORDER BY side-channel techniques
